notes: Not written by the 2026-09-28 rotation-accuracy class audit; this records what a real one needs. Unlike Holy, Protection's damage kit is fully implemented and single-target-testable today (Judgement, Holy Strike, Consecration, Exorcism, Hammer of Wrath, Seal of Righteousness/Command, Holy Shield -- see sim/paladin/*.go), so a priority list is a smaller lift than Holy's -- what is missing is threat and mitigation awareness, not new spells: (1) Righteous Fury (sim/paladin/righteous_fury.go) is an Options-gated boolean threat-multiplier aura, not a rotation-cast spell, so it needs no APL line at all, only PaladinOptions.RighteousFury set true on the request -- a real list should say this explicitly rather than silently omit it. (2) Holy Shield (sim/paladin/holy_shield.go) is a talent-gated, charge-based block buff (4 charges, ranks at 30/50/60) that should be re-cast once its charges or duration run low, the same shape as this spec's Seal-remaining-time line but keyed off an aura-charge value the APL system would need surfaced (checked: APLValueAuraRemainingTime exists in proto/apl.proto; an aura-CHARGES value was not found in a quick pass of apl.proto's message list, and needs confirming before this can be written correctly). (3) A tanking Protection rotation cares about threat, not damage, as its ranking signal -- UnitMetrics already carries a Threat DistributionMetrics field (sim/core/proto/api.pb.go), unused for paladin today, so scoring this spec's own rotation choices means comparing candidates on Threat, not Dps, once written -- a threat encounter/gear ranking mode this program has not needed for any DPS spec yet. (4) Consecration and Holy Strike, the two abilities added to the client this week and covered by this pass's Retribution rotation (data/curated/apl/paladin-retribution.json's notes), read straightforwardly here too; the guide's hand-written prose (web/src/content/guides/paladin/protection.md's Rotation section) had two factual errors this pass fixed directly against sim/paladin/holy_strike.go and judgement.go -- Holy Strike's cooldown is 10s and shares the GCD (the prose said 12s, independent of the GCD), and Judgement still consumes whichever Seal is active when it fires in this engine (the prose said it no longer costs the Seal at all, true of some later expansions but not of this build's own judgement.go). The prose is accurate now; the JSON priority list itself still needs writing once threat-scoring exists.
